description: Query Redfin parcel-level listings and multi-unit condo/apartment tower summaries for any US ZIP code or city, returning exact lat/lon coordinates, HOA monthly dues, price/sqft, days on market, 3D tour availability, and building unit inventory. Cost: 2 Credits / parcel returned (0 Credits if empty).

limit.description: Max normalized Redfin parcels to return (1–50).

name: search_redfin_parcels

code.description: Status code (0 for success, -1 for error).

data.description: Normalized Redfin parcel inventory and multi-unit building rollups.

buildings_summary.description: Summary of multi-unit condo/apartment buildings with active unit counts.

properties.description: Normalized parcel listings with coordinates, HOA monthly dues, price/sqft, days on market, and specs.

total_parcels_matched.description: Total matching Redfin parcels in the area.

meta.description: Request execution metadata including request ID, credits charged, cache status, and latency.

cached.description: Whether the response was served from the 6-hour write-through cache.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on empty or error).

request_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this API request.

took_ms.description: Total gateway execution time in milliseconds.

title: Search Redfin Parcel, HOA, Coordinates & Multi-Unit Building Data
